articles.title: New educational program developed for an often-overlooked group of gifted children
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: Pupils from families with a lower socio-economic status (SES) perform less well at school than children from families with a high socio-economic status. They are also less likely to be identified as gifted pupils. Ph.D. candidate Lineke van Tricht has developed a program for schools to help pupils with a low SES make the most of their talents. "This is important for the young people themselves, but also for society as a whole," says Van Tricht, who will defend her thesis at Radboud University on 8 December 2026.
